newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-UMAGA RETURNS TO NZ TEAM VS SPRINGBOKS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-UMAGA RETURNS TO NZ TEAM VS SPRINGBOKS.

text.p: Tana Umaga regains his wing berth in the only change to the All Black team for Saturday week's return tri-series rugby test against the Springboks at Eden Park.
The strong-running winger was forced to miss last Saturday's 33-18 win over the Wallabies in Melbourne following a shoulder and sternum injury he sustained the week before against South Africa.
His replacement in Melbourne, Glen Osborne, has been relegated to the eight-strong reserve bench, which now includes Scott McLeod in place of Lee Stensness.
Stensness has been dropped from the squad but coach John Hart said he remained a contender for the end-of-year tour of Britain.
Stensness played in all the tests at second five-eighth this year except in Melbourne, where he was replaced by Alama Ieremia.

All Blacks: 15-Christian Cullen; 14-Jeff Wilson, 13-Frank Bunce, 12-Alama Ieremia, 11-Tana Umaga, 10-Carlos Spencer, 9-Justin Marshall, 8-Zinzan Brooke, 7-Josh Kronfeld, 6-Taine Randell, 5-Ian Jones, 4-Robin Brooke, 3-Olo Brown, 2-Sean Fitzpatrick (captain), 1-Craig Dowd.
Reserves (from): Glen Osborne, Scott McLeod, Andrew Mehrtens, Ofisa Tonu'u, Mark Carter, Charles Riechelmann, Mark Allen, Norm Hewitt.
